Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 25

“As the ignorant act with attachment to their work, Bharata, so should the wise act without attachment, desiring the welfare of the world.”

The two look identical from outside — same diligence, same care. Krishna is not asking for visibly different behaviour, only for a different engine running beneath it.
